summary: Solaris Energy Infrastructure, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing that subsidiary Solaris Energy Infrastructure, LLC intends to offer $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of Senior Notes due 2032 in a private placement under Rule 144A and Regulation S. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, growth capital expenditures and offering fees. No price, coupon, premium or closing date is stated; no advisor is named. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown by the issuer, not a special situation; watch pricing, coupon and any use-of-proceeds shifts tied to growth capex.
